# Sutra Haus

> Sutra Haus is an owner-led web & media consultancy in India that rebuilds hotel
> websites into fast, booking-first experiences and produces bespoke social-media
> creatives (images and reels). It also builds complete consumer brands end-to-end.
> Nothing is template-based: every website and creative is designed from zero for
> the client's own brand.

## Facts

- Business name: Sutra Haus
- Owner: Badal Kariwal
- Contact: badal@sutrahaus.com
- Website: https://sutrahaus.com/
- Country: India (works remotely across India)
- Specialty: premium website design & rebuilds for hotels, resorts and banquet
  venues; bespoke Instagram/social image creatives; cinematic reels; brand builds
- Registered Indian business; GST details available on request

## Services & packages

- Neev (नींव, "the foundation"): complete website rebuild + managed hosting,
  booking-engine integration (e.g. STAAH), live OTA rate comparison, SEO/AI-search
  readiness, WhatsApp & click-to-call.
- Shringaar (श्रृंगार, "the adornment"): everything in Neev plus a monthly set of
  bespoke image creatives for Instagram and social media, festival & wedding-season
  campaigns, captions and grid direction.
- Shahkaar (शाहकार, "the masterpiece"): everything in Shringaar plus cinematic
  reels, research-driven hooks, shot lists, a monthly content calendar and
  priority turnaround.
- Every engagement starts with a free reimagined homepage concept.

## Proof of work

- Chinmaye (Bhagalpur, Bihar): rebuilt the digital presence of Hotel Chinmaye Inn
  (60 rooms, rooftop restaurant Kesaria, five banquet halls) — premium website with
  Lighthouse mobile scores in the 90s, STAAH direct booking, and a live rate strip
  showing direct prices ~30% cheaper than OTAs (auto-refreshed 3× a day). Also
  shipped 125+ bespoke Instagram creatives. Case study:
  https://sutrahaus.com/work/chinmaye/ — live site: https://chinmayeinn.sutrabox.com
- Ephoria: a direct-to-consumer wellness brand built entirely by Sutra Haus —
  identity, packaging visuals, ten-product line, full e-commerce store, product &
  lifestyle photography and content. Case study:
  https://sutrahaus.com/work/ephoria/ — live store: https://ephoria.store

## How to engage

Email badal@sutrahaus.com with the property or brand name. Sutra Haus studies the
current website and Instagram, then shares a free reimagined homepage concept
before any commitment.
